scripts.ci: dotnet r format-check && dotnet r build && dotnet r test
scripts.add-migration: dotnet ef migrations add (Read-Host 'Migration name') --project Data/EvilCase.Data.Migrations --configuration Release
scripts.remove-migration: dotnet ef migrations remove --force --project Data/EvilCase.Data.Migrations --configuration Release
scripts.generate-sql-script: dotnet ef migrations script 0 --idempotent --project Data/EvilCase.Data.Migrations --output database.sql --configuration Release
